pose: Landscape environment master shot featuring a vibrant, stylized canyon river valley. A bright, high-key sun shines from a light blue sky filled with soft, puffy white clouds. A winding, clear blue river snakes through multi-layered, warm ochre and terracotta sandstone cliffs. The foreground is lush with detailed bright green grasses, primitive ferns, large broadleaf foliage, and patches of small orange and purple wildflowers. Distinctly rounded, chunky conifer trees with dense, textured foliage blocks are dotted across the plateaus, transitioning into soft, hazy canyon steps in the far distance.
